about.title: About DocIntegrity
about.subtitle: Web-based document integrity control system powered by smart contracts
about.what_desc: DocIntegrity is a decentralized platform for registering and verifying electronic documents using blockchain technology. The system allows you to record a unique digital fingerprint (SHA-256 hash) of any file on the Ethereum blockchain, providing immutable proof of the document's existence at a specific point in time.
about.how_desc: A blockchain is a distributed ledger where every record is immutable. When you register a document, its hash is written to a smart contract on the Ethereum network. This record cannot be modified or deleted, ensuring absolute integrity guarantee.
about.faq1_q: Is this safe for my files?
about.faq1_a: Absolutely safe. Your files never leave your device. Only the hash — a mathematical fingerprint of the file — is recorded on the blockchain. The original file cannot be restored from it.
about.faq2_a: Registration costs a small fee in ETH plus the Ethereum network gas fee. You'll see the exact amount before confirming the transaction.
about.faq3_a: MetaMask is a cryptocurrency wallet that works as a browser extension. It's needed to connect to the Ethereum blockchain and sign transactions.
about.faq4_q: Can I delete a registered document?
about.faq4_a: Physically deleting a record from the blockchain is impossible, but you can revoke a document — it will be marked as inactive.
